title: Advertisement for the Post of Junior Research Fellow

FULL TEXT:
Walk in Interview on 27 September 2024 at 2.00 pm
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in
Research Project entitled “Climate Compatible Growth” funded by the Government of the
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland acting through the Foreign,
Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO). Panjab University is a National
Coordinating Agency. It will establish and run a CCG network consisting of Special interest
groups; facilitate collaborative workshops, stakeholder meetings and capacity building
activities; report on monitoring and evaluating India network activities along with strategic
planning and documentation.
Posts is initially up to 31st March 2025. Post is purely on contract basis and co-terminus with
the term period of the project.
Post 1: Junior Research Fellow (No. of Posts: 1)
a) Qualification:
Essential: Master in Journalism /Communication/allied/English/Public Administration or
MSc/M.Tech in Environment Science, Environment Science and Engineering/ allied/ Public
health from a recognised Institution
Desirable: Familiarity with the areas of climate change/climate compatible growth/
sustainability/environmental budgeting/related areas.
b) Salary: Rs. 45000/- per month (fixed)
a) Job Requirement:
 A motivated, multi-skilled candidate.
 Ability to make presentations, write academic papers, reports and communicate
effectively and collaborate with researchers from diverse disciplines.
 Ability to assist with the organisation of workshops, meetings, outreach activities and
general management.
 Ability to work with qualitative and quantitative data.
 Documentation and Record Keeping.
Candidate should appear for walking interview on 27 September 2024 at 2.00 pm in room
no 227, Department of Environment Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh along with
Applications, bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience, publications.
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/DK1riqm3CgKgEiz78
by 26 September 2024. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and
regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency will govern the selected
candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator
E-mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
